requirements.title: Mark a color as Core Color
requirements.description: Give the Brand/Admin a way to mark one of their colors as a "Core Color" (Brand recommended color) on the Colors By Brand page.

source.file: brd/RD_Core Colors Toggle in Colors By Brand Page.docx

requirements.title: Core color setting on Colors By Brand page
requirements.description: Add a control to the Colors By Brand page that an admin can use to indicate whether a color is one of the brand's Core Colors.

source.file: brd/RD_Core Colors Toggle in Colors By Brand Page.docx
source.section: Goal / Initial Requirements

requirements.title: Core Color toggle follows Active toggle pattern
requirements.description: The Core Color (recommended color) toggle on the index page is linked to a single-select control on each color's page, like the existing Active toggle (stated as a potential solution).

source.file: brd/RD_Core Colors Toggle in Colors By Brand Page.docx
source.section: Potential solution

requirements.title: Admin access path
requirements.description: The feature is accessed at QX7 > Master Data > Colors > Colors By Brand.

requirements.title: Applies to all brands
requirements.description: The Core Color feature applies to ALL brands.

source.section: Header (Brand: ALL) / Products Checklist

requirements.title: Core Color column on index
requirements.description: The Colors By Brand index page displays a new column titled "CORE COLOR".

source.file: brd/RD_Core Colors Toggle in Colors By Brand Page.docx
source.section: FR 1 Colors By Brand Index Page

requirements.title: Core Color column shows toggle per row
requirements.description: Each color row on the index page shows a Core Color toggle (on/off) reflecting whether that color is a Core Color.

source.file: brd/RD_Core Colors Toggle in Colors By Brand Page.docx
source.section: FR 1 Colors By Brand Index Page

requirements.title: Core Color column placement
requirements.description: The Core Color column is placed after Sort Order and immediately before Active Status.

source.section: FR 1 Colors By Brand Index Page

requirements.title: Core Color toggle editable from index
requirements.description: The admin can switch the Core Color toggle from the index page, in the same manner as the Active Status toggle (inferred from goal text and image).

source.file: brd/RD_Core Colors Toggle in Colors By Brand Page.docx
source.section: FR 1 Colors By Brand Index Page

requirements.title: Core Color toggle on edit form
requirements.description: The Edit Color By Brand form includes a "Core Color" toggle field with an On/Off label.

source.section: FR 2 Edit Color By Brand

requirements.title: Core Color toggle placement on edit form
requirements.description: On the Edit form, the Core Color toggle appears after Sort Order and before Active Status.

source.file: brd/RD_Core Colors Toggle in Colors By Brand Page.docx
source.section: FR 2 Edit Color By Brand

requirements.title: Core Color saved on Save
requirements.description: Saving the Edit Color By Brand form persists the Core Color toggle value for that brand color.

source.file: brd/RD_Core Colors Toggle in Colors By Brand Page.docx
source.section: FR 2 Edit Color By Brand

requirements.title: Edit form value reflects stored state
requirements.description: The Edit form shows the toggle in its currently stored state (e.g. On for White - W in the example).

source.file: brd/RD_Core Colors Toggle in Colors By Brand Page.docx
source.section: FR 2 Edit Color By Brand

requirements.title: Index and edit toggle stay in sync
requirements.description: The Core Color value set on the index page and on the edit page reflect the same underlying value (linked, as with the Active toggle).
